tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i bskang gso dngos grub rol mtsho bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī de byai pū ri ka siddhi ka ke lyabdhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal lha mo'i bskang ba dngos grub rol mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang rdo rje 'dzin pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan dbang sngon sa 'dzin phrag po'i ngos/ /rab gsal nyi zla'i snang brnyan cher gsal ltar/ /shin tu brjid chags drag mo'i skur ston pa'i/ /bstan srung rnams kyis rtag tu dge legs mdzod/ /de mnyes byed pa'i tshul mang rab gsungs kyang / /don gyi gtso bo bsnyen bsgrub mthar phyin nas/ /dam tshig sdom la nan tan byed pa ni/ /thun mong mchog gi myu gu skyed byed yin/ /gnas skabs lam gyi bar chad sel ba dang / /'dod pa'i don 'ga' bsgrub la cher mngags pa'i/ /mdos dang gtor mas thugs dam bskang ba'i thabs/ /nam gru mnyes byed dngos grub rol mtsho bri/ /dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma zhes grags pa 'di nyid mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos 'chi med mdzod dang / de'i 'grel pa rab 'byor zla bas mdzad pa dang / yang sna tshogs gsal ba zhes bya ba/ ming gzhan mu tig phreng ba slob dpon dpal 'dzin sdes mdzad pa sogs las lha mo u ma dang gcig par bshad nas ming gi rnam grangs dgu bcu rtsa gsum gsungs shing / gzungs 'dus kyi nang du lha mo'i bstod pa dang mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa bshad/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i rgyud rnams las sngags bsrung lha mo'i sgrub thabs rab tu mang po dang / lhag ma'i skabs su yang rgyas par bshad la/ gsang sngags gsar 'gyur gyi bya ba'i rgyud rig pa mchog gam legs par grub pa'i rgyud las/ phyag na rdo rje nam gru'i rigs dang cho 'brang la bstod nas/ sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor du bcug nas dbang bskur te gsang sngags spyi'i srung mar bskos shing / rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud rdo rje gdan bzhi da nga /

rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang / kye rdor brtag gnyis dang sam bu ṭa'i rgyud sogs las yul nyer bzhi dang / gnas so gnyis kyi nang tshan/ de bī ko ṭa ces pa/ bod skad du/ lha mo'i mkhar zhes par gnas nas zhing skyong ma mo thams cad kyi gtso mo mdzad par bshad/ phyi rol pa'i lha mo gnas mkhar dang / gnas 'jog gi rgyud sogs las kyang ches mang bar bshad la/ bod du bka' srol yang / bla ma mal lo tsā ba nas rje sa skya pa yab sras sogs las brgyud pa dang / yang jo bo nā ro ta pa nas mar pa lo tsā la brgyud de mtshan dung sol lha mor btags pa'i mo rkyang gi bsgrub skor sogs rab tu mang bar snang ba las/ 'dir dpal brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po'i zhabs yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i bka' srung rnams kyi gtso bo thugs dam gyi yang snying / rdo rje gur gyi mgon po la lcam dral sbags sgrub dang / rkyang sgrub sogs zab cing rgya che bar 'byung ba las/ bye brag tu lha mo nyid kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i tshul la gsum ste/ sbyor ba rten dang mdos gtor mchod pa bshams pa'i tshul/ dngos gzhi bdag mdun bskyed cing thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga rjes phrin las bskul zhing smon lam bkra shis kyis mtha' brtan par bya'o/ dang po ni/ gnas khang yid du 'ong bar phyag dar rkyang nul legs par byas la bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams stegs mtho bar bzhugs pa'i mdun du gcan gzan gyi lpags pa'am ras gtsang ma'i khar nas 'bras sogs 'bru sna bkram pa'i steng du/ nang mdo lugs kyi khyad par yod na g.yon nas 'go rtsom zhing / min na mchod gtor gyi 'go rnal 'byor pa'i g.yas phyogs nas bzung ste/ ji ltar dgos pa'i yi dam chos skyong srung ma'i gtor ma dang / khyad par 'di nyid kyi gtor ma stod zur gsum/ smad zlum po mtheb kyus bskor ba'i rtse mor nyi zla nor bu sogs kyis brgyan pa'o/

/bskang ba'i gtor ma bshos bu gru gsum smug rtsis byugs pa mar gyi rgyan sna tshogs pa phyag mtshan gyi gzugs brnyan bcos pas brgyan pa/ khor yug tu sha mar thud/ bu ram/ 'khur ba 'bras chan sran btsos/ la du/ la phug shing tog sna tshogs gzhan yang sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i zas sna gang 'dzom dang / khyad par thod pa'am rin po che'i snod du/ rnal 'byor pa'i g.yas su rakta g.yon du chang phud gtsang mar bdud rtsi ril bu btab la/ gtor ma'i mdun du 'phral la 'thor rgyu'i chang yang bshams/ rnyed na thod pa mtshan ldan gyi nang nal bu'i sha khrag gis bkang ba/ khyim bya nag mo dngos sam/ gzugs bcos pa la rgyan gyis spras pa/ gzhan yang bya nag rta g.yag khyi lug mi nag dre'u/ bong bu nag mo sogs srog can gzugs sna tshogs dngos sam bcos la/ stag gzig go khrab/ gos dar/ gser g.yu/ ja sman/ ral gri/ mdung / rtse gsum sogs mtshon cha'i tshogs dang / khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga'i me tog sogs drag po'i mchod rdzas gang 'byor bkod pa legs shing mdzes par bshams/ rnga/ sil snyan/ dung / rkang gling / rdo rje dril bu/ ḍa ma ru/ nang mchod rnams lag len ltar bsgrigs/ yang mdos byed na ji ltar 'os pa'i sar shing ngam/ 'jim pa la ri rab bang rim bzhi pa/ mthar gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ lcags ri dang bcas pa/ tshon gyis kha dog bsgyur ba la/ rin po che sna lnga brdar ba/ khog snying gser g.yu gang rung bcug pa'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ gur zhal gyi nam mkha' dang bcas pa/ bang rim gnyis pa la nam mkha' bzhi/ rgyang bu bzhi/ bar bar du bya nag dgu bang rim gsum pa la rta/ g.yag lug khyi/ mi nag bud med/ dre'u/ zhon pa rnams dgu dgu mda' 'phang khra bo dgus bskor/ bang rim bzhi pa la nam mkha' brgyad dang / rgyang bu brgya/ pho gdong mo gdong khram shing rnams dgu dgu zhal bu dgu/ chang bu dgu mtheb kyu dgu rnams bkod/ mdos kyi mdun du glud gzugs dbang po tshang zhing dod pa gos rgyan sogs bskang ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar dang /

bshos bu dmar po dgu mchod pa khrag gi arghaṃ nyer spyod lnga rnams bshams/ mdos kyi dbus su mda' bya rgod ma dar snas brgyan pa dang / mdor na dgos pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med par 'dus bya ba ni sbyor ba'i cho ga'o// //gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga la bzhi/ bdag mdun bskyed pa/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa/ mchod gtor gyi thugs dam bskang ba/ mdos kyis bskang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sngon 'gro'i gtor chung gcig chu chang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarb+ba bighnān sogs gsum gyis bsngo/ gang zhig 'byung po mthu chen dang sogs kyis rol mo dang bcas bgegs bskrad/ bdag bskyed ni/ kye rdor/ bde mchog phur pa gang rung rang rang gi dkyus bzhin byas rjes/ mdun gyi gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la byin gyis brlabs nas/ yi dam so so la mchod gtor cho ga ltar phul te/ slar mgon po lcam dral 'khor bcas gtor chog bzhin bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs bstim dam la bzhag gtor ma phul/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ de nas dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa/ las mgon rnams dang / mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ gzhi bdag sogs la phul nas/ spyi bshags tshar gsum bya'o/ /gnyis pa ye shes pa spyan drangs pa ni/ mdun gyi mdos gtor phyogs gcig byin rlabs byed na/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bya zhing / yang mdos byin rlabs 'og tu byed na/ mchod gtor rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lis bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang thod pa mkhar gyi gzhal yas khang / bse smug po'i sgo can/ steng du zhing lpags kyi bla bre/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi rus pa'i phreng ba la sogs pas brgyan pa'i nang du a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dgra bgegs bkug nas bsgral ba'i sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gtor ma ri dang rgya mtshor mnyam pa/ khrag gi arghaṃ/

dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi sgron me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ dung chen gyi gling bu/ gzhan yang bya nag rta nag g.yag nag lug nag khyi nag mi nag dre'u nag mo/ bong bu gwa dmar/ khyim bya nag mo/ stag gzig go khrab/ gos dar la sogs pa dam rdzas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ā warta ya/ ho badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas sum cu rtsa gsum/ de wī ko ṭa sogs yul nyer bzhi nas dpal lha mo 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro bye bas bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ rnga dang sil snyan brdung zhing dbyangs dang bcas pas/ bhyoḥchos dbyings spros bral mkha' dbyings dag pa'i klong / /ma g.yos bstan bsrungs drag mo'i skur bstan nas/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro las la 'gyed mdzad pa'i/ /ma gcig lha mo 'dir byon stong grogs mdzod/ /'dod khams lha mo'i gtso mo mdzad rtsa na/ /ri rab lhun po'i rtse mor yongs 'du'i shing / /rnam rgyal khang bzang nye bar brten bcas ma/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas nas gshegs su gsol/ /'dzam gling zhing skyong gtso mo mdzad tsa na/ /de bī ko ṭar bha ṭa'i shing brten nas/ /'bum sde'i sha za kun du skyong mdzad ma/ /lha mo'i mkhar nas sku bskyod gnas༞ /yab gcig lha chen mnyes par mdzad pa'i tshe/ /tii se'i gangs la gnas bcas nag mo 'bum/ sprul par mdzad cing ma rungs tshar gcod ma/ /kha che'i dur khrod mchog nas gshegs su gsol/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa kun tu bsrung mdzad cing / /dam nyams phyi nang dgra bgegs sgrol ba dang / /rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i don rnams sgrub pa'i phyir/ /brtse bar dgongs te gnas 'dir da lta byon/ oṃ hūm̐ shri ye de bī kā li ma hā kā li de wī sa pa ri wā ra mā tri ḍā ki ni/

yakṣa se na kā li badzra sa mā dzaḥ.ā karṣa ya e hye hi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gsum pa mchod gtor gyi thugs dam bskang ba la bzhi/ byon skyems sman raka gtor ma 'bul ba/ bstod pas mnyes par bya ba/ bskang ba dngos/ bshags pa bya ba'o/ /dang po byon skyems sman raka gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ bhyoḥsna tshogs chu skyes nyin byed mi ro'i steng / /rtag tu thugs rje'i spyan gyis mi g.yel bar/ /rab dges lus dang grib ma'i tshul lta bur/ /ma gcig 'dir byon brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī de bī ma hā kā li badzra ā sa na tiṣṭhantu/ lha mi'i btung ba'i ro bcud kun bsdus pa/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lnga sbyar ba'i/ /sman phud mchog dang dgra bgegs bsgral ba yi/ /dmar gyi arghaṃ rgya mtsho 'di bzhes shig /oṃ shrī de bī ma hā kā li ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta pi pa tha hūm̐ phaṭa/ dum gsum thod pa dkar po yangs pa'i nang / ma hā māṃ sa sgron ma ye shes lnga/ rab mdzes dar gyi cod paṇa dang bcas pa'i/ rgya chen mchod gtor 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shri de wī ma hā kā li sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi sarb+ba siddhimme pra yatstsha shā trūnda bighnan mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ gnyis pa bstod pas mnyes par bya ba ni/ bhyoḥdapal ldan lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ snang srid 'khor 'das kun la dbang bsgyur yang / /gnas gsum zhing skyong mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo khyod/ /bdag la brtser dgongs dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes/ /sems can don la rjes chags rakta'i mtshor/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang par ldan pa'i mgrin bzang steng / /tshul khrims zhing lpags rlon pas bkab pa'i dbus/ /khyod sku mi 'gyur dbang sngon lhun po ni/ /chos kun ro gcig zhal gyi dkyil 'khor can/ /'dzum sgeg dpa' zhing drag mo'i tshul ston pa/ /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i spyan gsum dang / /tshad med rang bzhin phyag gi sor mo rnams/

/'dod chags gcod pa'i ye shes ral gri rno/ /zhe sdang mgo bo bcad pa'i thod khrag can/ /gti mug sad mdzad shakti'i mtshon cha dang / /dug gsum dgra bo tshar gcod tri shu la/ /thabs shes zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog zung 'jug sku/ /rigs lnga'i rang bzhin thod skam dbu brgyan zhing / /brgya phyed ma mo'i khrag 'dzag mgo bo'i phreng / /pha rol phyin drug rus pa'i rgyan cha can/ /mi lpags glang chen ba lang ko rlon dang / /re lde'i sham thabs mtshon sna'i gru gu bsnams/ /nad rkyal cho lo khram shing la sogs brgyan/ /spyi bor zla tshes snyan cha g.yas g.yon la/ /dug sbrul seng ge lte bar rta ljang can/ /rnam shes brgyad dag sbrul gyi chun po dang / /ma rig dug sel rma bya'i gtsug phud sogs/ /dbang phyug drag mo'i chas kyis rab tu brjid/ /khrag zhag thig le thal chen tshom bu can/ /de ltar cho 'phrul sna tshogs rab ston pa/ /drag mo me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na bzhugs/ /khams gsum dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum pa bskang ba dngos ni/ /bhyoḥrin chen lnga las grub pa'i gzhal med khang / /nang ltar dur khrod rol pa'i thod mkhar dbus/ /zhing lpags bla bre khrag zhag byugs pa'i gzhir/ /glo snying phreng ba rgyu ma'i dra phyed dang / /rus pa'i tral cham mi ro'i rgyal mtshan can/ /tsitta'i tog gis brgyan pa'i khang bzang du/ /dgra bgegs thod pa yangs shing rgya che bar/ /phyi nang dam nyams bsgral ba'i sha rus kyi/ /bza' ba khrag chen btung ba rgya mtshor bskyil/ /rakta'i arghaṃ mig sogs dbang po lnga'i/ /me tog tshil chen bsregs pa'i bdug spos dang / /zhun chen snang gsal khrag zhag dri chab mchog /don snying zhal zas rkang gling thod rnga sogs/ /rol mo'i bye brag snyan cing brjid pa'i dbyangs/ /dbyar skyes 'khrig 'dra'i g.yag rgod rog po dang / /glog ltar myur 'gro'i rta mchog sga srab can/ /margad 'khyil pa'i rwa ldan lug nag dang /

/seng ge'i stobs ldan khyi nag 'brug gi sgra/ /mthu stobs thogs med mon pa pho mo'i tshogs/ /dar gyi thod dang dung long rna cha can/ /ma rung snying rtsa 'dren pa'i spar ba gdengs/ /mu tig gser g.yu'i rgyan chas spras pa yi/ /khyim bya nag mo spu sdug mdzes pa dang / /dar gyi lda ldi yid 'ong ro bcud ldan/ /shing tog sna tshogs spud pa'i dpag bsam shing / /laṅka'i yul gyi mgrin bzang gwa dmar can/ /dre'u dmar nag nal bu'i sha khrag dang / /dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal ba'i ya lad tshogs/ /ral gri mdung dang thod khrag tri shū la/ /mda' gzhu dgra sta gtun shing kha twāṃ ga /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu dang / /'khor lo rdo rje la sogs mtshon cha'i tshogs/ /stag gzig gung dang kṛṣṇa sā ra sogs/ /spu sdug lpags pa'i tshogs dang thun mong gi/ /mchod rdzas yid 'phrog 'dod yon rnam pa lnga/ /gzhan yang lha mi'i longs spyod nam mkha'i khams/ /rab tu gang bar dngos bshams yid sprul nas/ /gus pa'i yid kyis rtag tu 'bul lags na/ /ye shes spyan gyis sgrib med nyer gzigs shing / /thugs rjes nges par dgongs la phrin las mdzod/ /de ltar rmad byung dam rdzas phyi nang gi/ /yum chen srid gsum bdag mo'i thugs dam bskang / /ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug༞ dpal ldan re ma ti yi༞ rdzong mo bka' bzlog gnyan mo'i༞ gangs ri'i bu mo legs ldan༞ gshin rje'i yum chen nag mo'i༞ bdud kyi lcam gcig nam gru'i༞ las bzhi sgrub mdzad phrin las nyer ston ma/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag lha mo'i thugs dam bskang / /lcags rkang srog gzer dung skyong rgyal mo dang / /lā ma yongs sgyur byis bcas mkha' 'gro ma/ /chu srin seng ge'i gdong can la sogs pa/ /la la rngams shing drag mo'i cha lugs can/ /kha gcig mdzes shing brjid pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /cho 'phrul ma nges sprul pa ci yang ston/ /nag mo 'bum sde'i 'khor tshogs༞

'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /sha za 'bum dang ma mo bye ba sogs/ /bka' nyan 'khor tshogs rnams kyi༞ khyed kyi thugs dam gnyan po skong gyur nas/ /thub pa'i bstan pa phyogs kun rgyas pa dang / /bstan 'dzin rnams kyang phrin las rab 'phel zhing / /'jig rten chos mthun bde zhing skyid par mdzod/ /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /khyed kyi sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs nas/ /'gal rkyen zhi zhing gnas skabs mthar thug gi/ /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /bzhi pa bshags pa bya ba ni/ bhyoḥ'agro ba'i don du sku mchog 'jigs pa la/ /ma lus khyad par gsal bar mdzad pa yi/ /nga rgyal dregs pa mtha' dag 'dul mdzad pa/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bka' dang dam tshig gtad nas gnyer mdzad ma/ /spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /dam bcas bka' las 'da' rgyu ma lags na/ /sku yi dam tshig tshul bzhin ma rtogs pa/ /khams gsum khyab pa'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /ma gcig bde gshegs rigs lnga dpal gyi yum/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed mdzad ma/ /ji bzhin 'gro ba mtha' dag der 'du ba'i/ /ma gcig sprul pa'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'dir 'dus gdung sob rnams/ /spyi dang khyad par dam tshig mi gtong yang / /klong du ma gyur rtsal shugs chung ba dang / /'du shes chung ba'i skyon rnams ci mchis pa/ /ma gcig lha mo'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /thugs rjes nges par gzigs pa'i lha mo la/ /dam rdzas tshang ba'i mchod pa ma bshams te/ /phang sems dbang gis mchod pa'i rgyu chung ba/ /rdzong mo bka' bzlog sku la bzod par gsol/ /ma gcig sku mdog phyag mtshan cha lugs la/ /don dang mthun pa'i tshul bzhin ma 'dres pas/ /lha mo'i thugs rjes g.yel bar ma gyur pas/ /bdud las rgyal ba'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /thams cad 'jigs tshul bdud las rgyal ba'i tshul/

/pags pas brgyan pa'i ko rlon sham thabs can/ /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms pa'i ska rags can/ /bdud 'joms lha mo'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /bu yi tshul gyis rgyun gyi dam tshig la/ /le lo gnyid dang bre mo'i gtam la sogs/ /thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa ci mchis pa/ /thugs rje chen pos tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /rnal 'byor gang zhig dam tshig 'dzin pa rnams/ /bu yi tshul du thams cad bsrung ba dang / /zhe sdang gdug pa'i dgra bgegs gang byung sar/ /ma gcig thugs rje ldan pa der byung zhing / /drag shul dbang dang mngon spyod phrin las kyis/ /ji ltar bsam pa bzhin du phrin las mdzod/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rdzong mo gnyan po yang / /dus ngan tha ma'i sems can mi gshegs te/ /'gro don byang chub sems kyi gshegs lags nas/ /re smon thams cad bdag la bstsal du gsol/ /zhes pa ni gtor mas thugs dam bskang ba'o/ /de nas bzhi pa mdos kyi bskang ba la gsum/ byin gyis brlab pa/ 'bul ba/ glud bsngo ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gong du bshad pa'i mdos la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shu ddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong sbyar/ sor mo rnams rtse sprad pa/ chos nyid rnam dag gi phyag rgya bcas te/ mdos kyi 'bags pa dang mi gtsang ba/ ma dag par snang ba thams cad stong par gyur/ oṃ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing / lag pa gnyis mnyam pa'i thal mo las sor mo dbus ma gsum gyi tshigs bar ma bcag pa/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas te/ mdos rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i ri rab gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa/ lcog brgyad dang ldan pa'i mtha' skor du gling bzhi gling phran brgyad lcags ri dang bcas pa'i steng du sku'i mtshon byed zhal gyi nam mkha' nag po'i mthar rin po che sna lnga'i gzha' ris kyis bskor ba/

gzhan yang mtha' skor du rin po che dang gos dar las byas pa'i nam mkha' rgyang bu/ bya nag rta nag g.yag nag lug nag khyi nag mi nag bud med nag mo dre'u zhon pa/ sha khrag bdud rtsi lnga'i zhal zas/ gser gyi snod rtsi bcud kyis gang ba/ dbus su thugs kyi rten rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ khor yug tu pho gdong skyes pa stag chas kyis brgyan pa bro 'khrab pa/ mo gdong bud med mdzes ma dar zab kyis brgyan pa glu len pa/ stag pa'i khram shing dgra bgegs zil gyis gnon pa/ ngar mi lus dang dbang po rdzogs shing gos dang rgyan nor sna tshogs kyis gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod la lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba kha phye la/ mthe bong bsnol ba bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya bcas nas/ mdos 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga tshang ba thams cad kyang / mgron so sos yid bzhin du thob pa la bgegs dang nyer 'tshe med par gyur/ oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇā nutpanna twād oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod lag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon mnyam gzhag byas pa/ mdos mgron so so'i gang la gang 'dod pa'i dngos po yid bzhin du 'byung bar gyur cig oṃ dzñā na a ba lo ki te/ na maḥs manta spha ra/ rasmi bha ba ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da dzwā la ya swā hā/ mgron rnams drag zhan che chung med par so so'i yid tshim zhing rang dbang du longs spyod par gyur/ zhes brjod cing / lag g.yon khu tshur bcangs pa pang du bzhag g.yas rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mo bsgreng pa'i sdigs mdzub bstan pa/ ye shes skar mda'i phyag rgya bya'o/ /na maḥs manta buddhā naṃ gra he shwa ri pra pañtsa ti ma hā sa ma ya hā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ mdos kyi mchod pa bskal pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du zad pa med cing mgron rnams mnyes pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig lag pa gnyis rdo rje nang bsdams spyi bo'i thad kar skor ba/

dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bya ste/ sngags re re'ang lan gsum gsum brjod cing / sngags re re la phyag rgya bca' thebs re'i mthar se gol re re gtog de dag gi mdos byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa mdos dbul ba ni/ bhyoḥdrag po'i gzhal yas mtshan nyid ldan pa 'dir/ dam rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bcas pa/ phyi nang mchod gtor 'dod yon sna tshogs bshams/ yid 'phrog bkod legs mdos kyi mchod pa ni/ /'bru sna rin chen lnga las legs grub pa'i/ /ri rab bang rim bzhi ldan lcog gi steng / /mthing nag 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad gur gyi dbus/ /thugs kyi rang bzhin rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /sku yi mtshon byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro yi/ /zhal gyi nam mkha' phyogs bzhir sangs rgyas dang / /rin chen padma sna tshogs mkha' 'gro rnams/ /mnyes byed nam mkha' bzhi dang rgyang bu bzhi/ /'jig rten las kyi mkha' 'gro sde brgyad la/ /khor yug nam mkha' mdzes pa brgyad kyis bskor/ /rab tu bkra ba'i rgyang bu'i phreng ba can/ mdung la dar btags bya nag rta mchog dang / /g.yag rog lug nag khyi nag mi nag tshogs/ /pho glud mda' khra mo glud 'phang khra dang / /dgra bgegs zil gnon stag pa'i khram shing dang / /pho gdong dpa' bo stag chas kyis brgyan pa/ /mo gdong bud med mdzes ma glu len cing / /re re'ang srin po'i grangs ldan phyogs kun khyab/ /gzhan yang rin chen sman sna dar mtshon dang / /stag gzig go khrab mtshon cha'i tshogs rnams kun/ /thugs kyi rten mchog nal bu'i sha khrag dang / /ljon shing sna tshogs khyim bya nag mo dang / /bong bu gwa dmar dre'u nag mo sogs/ /thun mong ma yin thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul lha mo'i longs spyod kyis/ /ma gcig lha mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /yum chen e ka dza ṭī'i༞ gshin rje'i yum chen bdud kyi sring mo mchog /dpal ldan nam gru chen mo'i༞

ba lang kṛṣṇa chu sring gdong can ma/ /seng ge'i gdong can lcags rkang srog gzer sogs/ /nad rims bdag mo 'bum sde'i thugs dam bskang / /so gnyis yul dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas/ /skyong mdzad ma mo mkha' 'gro'i༞ dur khrod brgyad gnas sha za mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'dir byon dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs kun rgyas pa dang / /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ /'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen bsam pa'i don/ /yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /gsum pa glud bsngo ba ni/ bhyoḥri rab gling bzhi lus kyi glud du bzhes/ /ngag gi glud du nam mkha' sna tshogs 'bul/ /rgyang bu'i phreng ba yid kyi glud du bzhes/ /'bru sna lnga ni phung po lnga yi glud/ /rin chen sna lnga 'byung ba lnga yi glud/ /dar mtshon sna tshogs rnam shes brgyad kyi glud/ /sha khrag sna tshogs khams dang skye mched glud/ /mda' 'phang khra bo pho dang mo yi glud/ /zang zing glud du srog chags sna tshogs 'bul/ /srog glud dam par ri rab mdos mchog dang / /rin chen 'bru sna lnga las grub pa yi/ /dbang po yongs rdzogs ngar mi lung thang mig /'gron bu'i so dang mu tig klad pa can/ /zer mo'i skra dang zho sha'i snying ldan pa/ /zangs ma'i sna dang smin ma g.yas g.yon g.yu/ /lag g.yas gser la g.yon pa dngul gyis byas/ /rkang pa g.yas g.yon lcags zangs gos dang nor/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i srog glud kyis/ /dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas rab dges nas/ /sngags 'chang rig 'dzin bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /bsam don bsgrubs la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs kun/ /myur du bsad cing bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig gzhan gyi rigs sngags rbod gtong byad kha dang / /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad bcu'i gnod pa zlog /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dang dal yams kun/ /dgra bo'i steng du phobs la tshar chod cig

/'khor du gnas pa'i nad bdag thams cad kyis/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i yul 'khor brlag par mdzod/ /ma mo'i khrag zor gshin rje'i 'khor lo dang / /phur pa'i dbal kha bon po'i btso dmar 'phen/ /klu bdud mnan gtad rgyal po'i thog brdzis dang / /dmu btsan gza' dang rgyu skar gnod pa zlog /mdor na zhi rgyas dbang drag thun mong gi/ /phrin las myur 'grub mthar thug bla med kyi/ /byang chub thob nas khams gsum kun sgrol zhing / /tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /gsum pa rjes phrin las bskul zhing smon lam bkra shis kyi mtha' brtan par bya ba la gsum/ bstod cing las la bskul ba/ 'phral gtor gtang la 'dod don bsgo ba/ lhag chad kha bskang zhing bzod gsol shis par bya'o/ /dang po ni gur gyi mgon po'i bstod pa gsar rnying gang rung dang / bye brag 'di nyid kyi bstod pa til mar ma'am/ phyag na rdo rjes nam gru'i rigs la bstod pa la gzhi byas kho bos brtsams pa de'am/ drag por byed na/ mi pham ma bskul dang bcas pa byed/ gzhan yang dpal mgon sogs la gang dgos kyi bstod pa rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la bya ste/ /zlog pa bdag chen blo gros pas mdzad pa'i lha mo'i bskang zlog bzhin bya'o/ /gnyis pa/ 'phral gtor btang la 'dod don bsgo ba ni/ lha'i tshogs rnams dang / rdo rje'i glu/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs byas rjes spyi stabs zhi drag gi dmigs pa gang dgos bsrung zlog bsad gsum gyi kha bsgyur dang bcas pa man ngag bzhin bya'o/ /gsum pa lhag chad kha bskang zhing bzod gsol shis par bya ba ni/ yig brgya brjod cing ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs dang / med pa la gshegs gsol skabs dang sbyar ba bsngo ba smon lam/ bkra shis kyi tshig 'jigs rung ma sogs byas nas rjes yo byad rnams mi mngon par bsdu'o/ /de ltar 'dod khams dpal ldan ma/

/mnyes par byed pa'i bskang ba'i thabs/ /dngos grub rol mtsho ces bya ba/ /shā kya'i dge slong sa skya pa/ /'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /lha mo dges pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig /nye bar mthong nas 'bad pa yis/ /bris pa'i dge bas thub pa yi/ /bstan pa yun du rgyas pa dang / /'jig rten log pa'i lam spangs nas/ /phan bde'i rta ljang phrin las kyis/ /snang brnyan rab tu rgyas gyur cig sa ka la pra dzā bhyaḥ sharma bha wantu/ /e waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i bskang gso/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 13
